candidate_sentences.text: During the financial year 2025, JLT Mobile Computers AB reported net sales of SEK 131.5 million, representing an increase of 11.1 percent compared to SEK 118.4 million in the previous year.

Order intake grew significantly by 37.5 percent to SEK 142.0 million compared to SEK 103.0 million previously, supported by strategic deals including a major SEK 22 million order from an American food producer.
The operating loss improved to SEK -1.9 million from SEK -9.7 million in 2024, while EBITDA stood at SEK -1.7 million compared to SEK -2.1 million.
Profit after tax improved to SEK -2.5 million from SEK -7.7 million.
The Board of Directors has proposed that no dividend be paid for the 2025 fiscal year.

verified_key_information_units.information: Operational impact of external challenges: geopolitical uncertainty suppressed demand in the largest segment (warehousing and logistics), a ~20% depreciation of the US dollar against the Swedish krona (affecting 74% of sales and gross margin), and customs duties on non-European components increased administrative costs and burden.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO letter (page 5-6) explicitly details geopolitical uncertainty, weak demand in logistics, currency effects (USD lost almost 20% against SEK), and customs duty impacts on inventory valuation and administrative workload.

candidate_sentences.text: The company’s financial performance was heavily impacted by external macroeconomic factors, specifically currency fluctuations and international trade uncertainties.

Furthermore, geopolitical uncertainty and unclear customs and tariff regulations caused a wait-and-see approach among end customers in the primary warehousing and logistics segment, while increasing internal administrative burdens and investigation costs.
